site_name: Garages & 1-30 Claire Court, Shoot Up Hill and 1-135 Watling Gardens, London, NW2
description: Non-material amendment to condition 3 (variation of the wording to alter the tenure mix of the affordable housing) of Deemed (Reg4 Councils Other Development) reference 21/2473 dated 25 April, 2022, for Demolition of 1-11 Watling Gardens, 1-30 Claire Court and the associated podium car parking and substation and redevelopment to provide 125 flats: 80 for general needs (Use Class: C3) and 45 for extra care (Use Class: C3(b)) in three separate buildings ranging from 3 to 14 storeys, alongside access improvements, car parking, cycle parking, refuse and recycling storage, amenity space, landscaping and other associated works
